Royal Feasts

A feast fit for kings

Two restaurants, a bar and a café, with cooking from across Asia and Europe, lavish buffets and a dessert table guests still talk about.

Scroll

Dining at The Pharo

Four tables, one kingdom

From family lunches to long dinners, high tea on the terrace and cocktails as the sun goes down, there's always a table waiting at The Pharo.

Our kitchens cook Indian, Indonesian, Italian and Sri Lankan dishes, pizza and Asian favourites. Guests talk about our buffets: one counted almost 40 desserts on the table.
